On-Chain Operator. Module 4 · Yield. Navy and cyan. This is the door, not the whole module. Education only.
You already have LTV, health factor, and liquidation from lending. A yield does not retire those numbers. It is payment for a risk you can name.
By the end of the module you will be able to do this: split any APY into organic vs subsidised, and name the risk being paid for. Not before. The lessons earn it one page at a time.

The lessons, in order, are 4.0 Mastery Starter, 4.1 Yield farming: base yield vs emissions, 4.2 Native staking, 4.3 Liquid staking, 4.4 Restaking & shared security, 4.5 Vaults & yield optimisers, 4.6 Airdrops & points: opportunity cost, 4.7 Stablecoin savings rates and yield-bearing stablecoins, 4.8 Tokenized treasuries and real-world assets. You do not skip ahead. Each page is the input to the next.
Lesson 4.0, Mastery Starter. Mastery Starter. You will write that down when you get there.
Lesson 4.1, Yield farming: base yield vs emissions. Split a farm's APY into what's earned from real activity and what's paid in newly minted tokens. You will write that down when you get there.
Lesson 4.2, Native staking. Understand what staking pays for, and its lock-up and validator risks. You will write that down when you get there.
Lesson 4.3, Liquid staking. Use liquid staking tokens knowing how they accrue value and how they can depeg. You will write that down when you get there.
Lesson 4.4, Restaking & shared security. Map the extra risk layers restaking adds before accepting its extra yield. You will write that down when you get there.
Lesson 4.5, Vaults & yield optimisers. Decide when a vault's fees are worth paying compared with doing it yourself. You will write that down when you get there.
Lesson 4.6, Airdrops & points: opportunity cost. Price airdrop and points farming as a bet, including its costs. You will write that down when you get there.
Lesson 4.7, Stablecoin savings rates and yield-bearing stablecoins. Tell apart the different ways a stablecoin can pay yield, and the risk behind each. You will write that down when you get there.
Lesson 4.8, Tokenized treasuries and real-world assets. Use tokenized real-world assets knowing what you actually own and who you're trusting. You will write that down when you get there.
Next is Lesson 4.0, Mastery Starter. Bring nothing but the habit: one idea, one drawing, the word Example on any number. Education only, not financial advice.
